commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0x00
commands.purpose: Toggle the power-button-disable global flag. req[8]=0x00, req[7]=2 (len). If param_1[9] (first data byte after selector) is 1 and a 'CMC-notified' flag is already set, returns CC 0x81 (busy/not allowed). If param_1[9] is 0 or 1, writes the value to a global byte flag. Values >= 2 → CC unspecified (falls to default CC 0xcc path). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9 addr 0x4449cd3c (dispatched via liboemcmds.so.9.9.9 registration).

commands.backendDeps: Global byte at DAT+0x4449d4a7 (power button disable flag); CMC-notified flag at DAT+0x4449ebfb.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0x02
commands.purpose: BIOS→BMC generic system info write (type 0x02). Calls FUN_44497ef8 to parse and store the system info record. On success additionally ORs a flag byte in SHM region 0x27 offset 0x2e4 with bit 0, then sets IMC status bit 0x100000. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0x02; req[9..]=system info payload (format handled by FUN_44497ef8).
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from FUN_44497ef8 on error, CC 0x00 on success.
commands.backendDeps: FUN_44497ef8 (writeSysInfo helper); Dell_shm_memwrite(region 0x27, offset 0x2e4); DellSetIMCStatusBit(0x100000).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0x03
commands.purpose: BIOS→BMC generic system info write (type 0x03). Identical to 0x02 but does not write the SHM flag byte. Calls FUN_44497ef8 then sets IMC status bit 0x100000. Case 0x01 aliases here (goto LAB_4449d2c8). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0x03 (or 0x01 which aliases here); req[9..]=system info payload.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from FUN_44497ef8; CC 0x00 on success.
commands.backendDeps: FUN_44497ef8 (writeSysInfo helper); DellSetIMCStatusBit(0x100000).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/default
commands.purpose: Catch-all: selectors with an empty 'break' case fall out of the switch to 'uVar20 = 0x80' (command/parameter not supported). Selectors 0xcc, 0xce, 0xcf, 0xd9, 0xdd, 0xe6, 0xeb, 0xec, 0xed, 0xf6 explicitly goto LAB_4449d218 → CC 0x82. All selectors with real handlers are documented as their own DellCmdSetSysInfo/* entries. commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xc1
commands.purpose: PCIe inventory-lock check. If the CMC PCIe inventory-in-progress flag is set, logs a message and returns WITHOUT modifying the CC — so the selector value 0xc1 is returned as the completion code (the handler does not set 0xcc here). Otherwise falls through to FUN_44497ef8 (LAB_4449d2a0). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xc1.
commands.response: CC 0xc1 (returns the unmodified selector byte) if CMC PCIe inventory in progress; else CC from FUN_44497ef8 (0x00 on success).
commands.backendDeps: Global int flag at DAT_4449ddf0+0x4449da44 (CMC PCIe inventory-in-progress).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xc2
commands.purpose: Set PCIe slot topology configuration (fpSetIPMIConfigAttrs). The lockdown path at the function entry also handles this selector: when IsSystemLockdownEnabled and selector>5, only specific slot-topology type/width values are accepted (validated bitmask at 0x2b200001); invalid types → CC 0xd4 (lockdown reject). On the non-lockdown path, validates slot type+width (CONCAT11(param_1[9],param_1[10])) against an allowlist: accepted values include {0x02, 0x03, 0x08, 0x100, 0x108, 0x200, 0x208, 0x308, 0x400, 0x800, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x8000, 0x10000}; all others → CC 0xcc. Also validates slot state byte at param_1[0x13] (must be 1 or 2). Calls fpSetIPMIConfigAttrs(param_1+9, data_len-1) and returns its CC. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[7]=data_len; req[8]=0xc2; req[9..10]=slot_type_width (u16 LE, validated against allowlist); req[0xd..0xe]=bus_device (u16 LE; if invalid loads from existing config); req[0x13]=slot_state (1 or 2; else clamped to 2); req[9+..] = full slot record passed to fpSetIPMIConfigAttrs.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from fpSetIPMIConfigAttrs; CC 0xd4 if lockdown rejects type; CC 0xcc if type or state validation fails.
commands.backendDeps: IsSystemLockdownEnabled; fpSetIPMIConfigAttrs; existing config read from DAT_4449de40 global.
commands.security: Lockdown bypass path: certain slot topology values are accepted even under lockdown. No in-band gate. An Admin LAN caller can overwrite PCIe slot topology records.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xc3
commands.purpose: Write system GUID and associated system info record. req[7] must equal 0x12 (18 bytes). If param_1[9]==0x10, calls SetSysGUID(param_1+10) to store the 16-byte GUID, then calls writeSysInfo(param_1+9, len-1, 0xc3) to persist the record. CC is OR of both operations. req[7]!=0x12 → CC 0xc7 (LAB_4449e0ac); req[9]!=0x10 → CC 0xcc (LAB_4449d580). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[7]=0x12; req[8]=0xc3; req[9]=0x10 (GUID type); req[10..25]=16-byte GUID (raw binary).
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC 0x00 on full success; CC 0xff if SetSysGUID fails; CC from writeSysInfo if that fails; CC 0xc7 (199, LAB_4449e0ac) if req[7]!=0x12; CC 0xcc (LAB_4449d580) if req[9]!=0x10.
commands.backendDeps: SetSysGUID (cfgdb GUID attribute write); writeSysInfo(type=0xc3).
commands.security: No in-band gate. Admin IPMI over LAN can overwrite system GUID.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xc4
commands.purpose: BIOS POST-complete notification: write system info record type 0xc4, set a cfgdb attribute to 1, and OR flag bit 1 into SHM region 0x27 offset 0x2e4. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xc4; req[9..]=system info payload (passed to writeSysInfo).
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from writeSysInfo; CC 0xff if cfgdb write fails.
commands.backendDeps: writeSysInfo(type=0xc4); CfgSetAttributeInt (POST-complete cfgdb attribute); Dell_shm_memwrite(region 0x27, offset 0x2e4).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xc5
commands.purpose: Update system node ID. Gated on IsMsgFromSystemInterface (in-band only) AND pre-POST (POST status byte not 0x51/0x7e/0x7f). Reads existing node ID from cfgdb, calls writeSysInfo(type=0xc5) and updateSystemNodeID, and if the value changed, triggers createRSPIFlashBackupThread and updates the 'previous' cfgdb attribute. OR-sets bit 2 in SHM region 0x27 offset 0x2e4. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xc5; req[9..]=node ID payload (passed to writeSysInfo). Gate: IsMsgFromSystemInterface must be non-zero (in-band only) when POST is not complete.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC 0x00 on success; CC from writeSysInfo or updateSystemNodeID on failure; falls to default (CC 0x00) if gate not met.
commands.backendDeps: IsMsgFromSystemInterface; CfgGetAttribute (node ID key); writeSysInfo(type=0xc5); updateSystemNodeID; createRSPIFlashBackupThread; Dell_shm_memwrite(region 0x27, offset 0x2e4); CfgSetAttribute.
commands.security: In-band gate enforced when system is pre-POST. Node ID update triggers flash backup thread.

commands.purpose: Write hardware version string to cfgdb. Calls writeSysInfo(type=0xc9), then if successful snprintf-formats a 4-char string from param_1[10] (low byte) and param_1[9] (high byte) in hex ('%%02x%%02x'), and writes it to a cfgdb attribute. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xc9; req[9]=version_high_byte; req[10]=version_low_byte.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from writeSysInfo; CC 0xff if cfgdb write fails; CC 0x00 on full success.
commands.backendDeps: writeSysInfo(type=0xc9); CfgSetAttribute (HW version cfgdb attribute).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xca
commands.purpose: Write system info record type 0xca (bounded). param_1[9] must be < 2 (else CC 0xcc). Calls writeSysInfo(param_1+9, len-1, 0xca). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xca; req[9]=type_selector (must be 0 or 1; else CC 0xcc); req[10..]=payload.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from writeSysInfo; CC 0xcc if param_1[9] >= 2.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xd6
commands.purpose: Local console / power-button control. req[7] must equal 5 (else CC 0xc7). Checks that an 'LCD capable' flag is non-zero (else CC 0xc1). param_1[9]==1: writes value 1 to writeSysInfo(type=0xd6) + sets IMC status bit 0x4000. param_1[9]==0x80: handles TRANS (serial) path; if 2-byte param_1[0xb..0xc] == 0 clears writeSysInfo, otherwise calls DellLocalConsoleTRANS with the u16 value; then sets IMC status bit 0x4000. Other values → CC 0xcc. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.

commands.response: resp_len=0; CC 0x00 on success; CC 0xc1 if LCD not capable; CC 0xcc if invalid op or param_1[0x80 trans] has negative byte; CC 0xc7 if req[7]!=5.
commands.backendDeps: writeSysInfo(type=0xd6); DellLocalConsoleTRANS; DellSetIMCStatusBit(0x4000); 'LCD capable' flag global.

commands.purpose: Node Manager control sub-dispatcher. param_1[9] selects action: 2=enable NM (NodeMgrSendOEMCmd 0xb8/0xdf + DellNodeMgrSetState()); 3 or 4=disable NM (DellNodeMgrSetState(1)); 5=host boot event (aim_event_occurred, ehtml5_HostBootEvent, Dell_set_EOPTime, DellAbsCBLPCResetFirstBoot); 6=trigger SetGPTaskEvent; 7=writeSysInfo(type=0xd7). Other values → default (CC 0x00). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xd7; req[9]=action (2=NM enable, 3/4=NM disable, 5=host boot event, 6=GP event, 7=write info).
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC 0x00 on success; CC 0xff if SetGPTaskEvent fails (for op=6).
commands.backendDeps: NodeMgrSendOEMCmd(0xb8, 0xdf); DellNodeMgrSetState; aim_event_occurred; ehtml5_HostBootEvent; Dell_set_EOPTime; CfgSetAttributeInt; DellAbsCBLPCResetFirstBoot; SetGPTaskEvent; writeSysInfo(type=0xd7).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xd8
commands.purpose: Set server power ceiling range. req[7] must equal 10 (else CC 0xc7). param_1[9] must be < 3. Generation-dependent range validation (gen<4: base 0x3c watts ± 0x21d (sVar6-0x3c < 0x21d); gen>=4: base 0x78 watts ± 0x1e1 (sVar6-0x78 < 0x1e1)). On success populates param_1[0xc..0xf] with ceiling/mode fields and calls writeSysInfo(type=0xd8). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.

commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from writeSysInfo; CC 0xc7 if req[7]!=10 or invalid subtype/range.
commands.backendDeps: Dell_get_generation; writeSysInfo(type=0xd8).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xda
commands.purpose: Write a binary cfgdb attribute (up to 0x20 entries). param_1[9] must be < 0x21 (33; else CC 0xcc). Calls CfgSetAttributeBin(key, param_1+9, param_1[9]*2+1, 0, 0). Used to write PCIe or similar binary table into cfgdb. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xda; req[9]=count (must be < 0x21); req[10..]=binary data (count*2 bytes).
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC 0x00 on success (falls to switchD default); CC 0xff if cfgdb write fails; CC 0xcc if count >= 0x21.
commands.backendDeps: CfgSetAttributeBin (iDRAC cfgdb binary attribute, key at DAT_4449dd68+0x4449d4c8).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xdc
commands.purpose: CMC-channel generic system info write. case 0xdc -> LAB_4449d24c: if param_1[0]>>4 != 7 the case breaks (falls to CC 0x80); if CMC channel, routes to FUN_44497ef8. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.

commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from FUN_44497ef8 on CMC channel; CC 0x80 if not CMC channel.
commands.backendDeps: FUN_44497ef8 (generic sysinfo parser).
commands.security: CMC channel gate only (param_1[0]>>4==7); NOT an in-band gate.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xdf
commands.purpose: CMC channel only (param_1[0]>>4==7). Full network address and chassis type configuration delivery from CMC. Opens a sentinel file, calls FUN_44497ef8 to store the data, then if success and a chassis-ready flag is set: updates SHM region 0xc (MAC address at offset 0x36f7), sets IP address in cfgdb (CfgSetAttribute, IPv4 or IPv6 via inet_ntop), sets management IP cfgdb attributes, updates cfgdb blade power-allocation and link-status flags, manages a periodic timer, conditionally writes to CPLD register 0xce5 based on chassis type (values 0=unknown/9, 1=small, 2=large, 5=rack), calls DellAbsIMCReadyCompleted. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[0]>>4 must equal 7 (CMC channel gate). req[8]=0xdf; req[9..]=network/chassis payload (MAC, IP address, chassis type, blade status bytes).
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC 0x00 on success; CC 0xff on any SHM/cfgdb write failure.
commands.backendDeps: fopen64 (sentinel files); FUN_44497ef8; Dell_shm_memwrite(region 0xc, offset 0x36f7); inet_ntop; CfgSetAttribute (mgmt IP, prev IP, MAC); CfgSetAttributeInt (power alloc, link status flags); _lx_TimerCreate/_lx_TimerDeactivate/_lx_TimerChange/_lx_TimerActivate; cpld_write_group(0xce5, chassis_type_code); aim_config_set_bool; Dell_set_modular_chassis_type; SetGPTaskEvent; DellAbsIMCReadyCompleted; DellCmcTriggerInventoryRequest.
commands.security: Gated on CMC channel (NOT in-band gate). Delivers trusted chassis topology, MAC, and IP data from CMC to iDRAC. Allows CMC to overwrite iDRAC management IP address and trigger CPLD and chassis type transitions.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xe0
commands.purpose: CMC-channel generic system info write (LAB_4449d24c, shared with 0xdc): if param_1[0]>>4 != 7 the case breaks (CC 0x80); if CMC channel, FUN_44497ef8. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[0]>>4 must equal 7 (CMC channel; else CC 0x80). req[8]=0xe0; req[9..]=payload.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from FUN_44497ef8 on CMC channel; CC 0x80 otherwise.
commands.backendDeps: FUN_44497ef8 (generic sysinfo parser).
commands.security: CMC channel gate only; NOT an in-band gate.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xe1
commands.purpose: Host power-on event record write. param_1[9] must be < 2 (else CC 0xcc). Calls writeSysInfo(type=0xe1) and if success sets IMC status bit 0x20000. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xe1; req[9]=type (0 or 1; else CC 0xcc); req[10..]=payload.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from writeSysInfo; CC 0xcc if param_1[9]>=2.
commands.backendDeps: writeSysInfo(type=0xe1); DellSetIMCStatusBit(0x20000).

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xe2
commands.purpose: VIS (Virtual Inventory/SysInfo) block write. req[9] (block index) must be <= 0x17 (else CC 0xc9). req[0xc..0xd]=block length (u16 LE, MakeUINT16(param_1[0xd],param_1[0xc])); req[0xe..0xf]=offset; req[0x10]=checksum byte; req[0x11..]=data. Sums req[0x11..0x11+len-1] and compares to req[0x10]; on match copies data into the VIS buffer array at base + index*0x400 + offset+3, records length/index/checksum, sets a 'block received' flag, and (if VIS not already enabled) arms a 100-tick timer. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xe2; req[9]=block_index (<=0x17; else CC 0xc9); req[0xc..0xd]=length (u16 LE); req[0xe..0xf]=offset (u16 LE); req[0x10]=checksum; req[0x11..]=block data.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC 0x00 on success; CC 0xc9 (201) if req[9]>0x17; CC 0xff on checksum mismatch or read/length error.
commands.backendDeps: MakeUINT16; memset/memcpy into VIS buffer array; DellAbs_Is_VIS_Enabled; _lx_Timer* (VIS timer); log_rloglev.
commands.security: Admin caller can write arbitrary blocks (<=0x400 each, up to index 0x17) into the VIS inventory buffer; checksum is integrity, not auth.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xe4
commands.purpose: Generic system info write. case 0xe4 -> LAB_4449d2a0 = FUN_44497ef8(param_1); returns its CC. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xe4; req[9..]=payload.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from FUN_44497ef8.

commands.purpose: CMC channel only (param_1[0]>>4==7). Write two cfgdb boolean attributes from two 1-bit fields in param_1[9]: bit 0 → first attribute (e.g. chassis power cap enable), bit 1 → second attribute (e.g. throttle mode). On cfgdb write failure returns CC 0xff. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[0]>>4 must equal 7 (CMC channel gate). req[8]=0xe5; req[7]=2; req[9]=flags byte (bit 0 and bit 1 used).

commands.backendDeps: CfgSetAttributeInt (two cfgdb attributes from DAT_4449df20+... and DAT_4449df30+...).
commands.security: CMC channel gate only (NOT in-band gate).

commands.purpose: Set IPMI status attributes (fpSetIPMIStatusAttrs). Checks a 'CMC PCIe not present' flag first (if set → CC 0xc1). Validates all four sub-fields: param_1[9]<2, param_1[10]<3, param_1[0xb]<2, param_1[0xc]<3 (else CC 0xcc). Calls fpSetIPMIStatusAttrs(param_1+9, len-1). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.

commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from fpSetIPMIStatusAttrs; CC 0xc1 if CMC not present flag set; CC 0xcc if any field out of range.
commands.backendDeps: fpSetIPMIStatusAttrs; CMC-present flag global at DAT_4449de3c+0x4449e048.

commands.purpose: Power profile delivery from BIOS. Calls writeSysInfo(type=0xe8), then reads a flag byte from SHM region 0x30 offset 0xb868, logs it, writes 1 back to SHM (sets 'power profile received' flag), calls DellPwrProfilesInfo_IPCClient() to notify power subsystem, then RunPowerInventory_DFSClient() and RegisterBIOSVersionInLCL(). Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xe8; req[9..]=power profile payload.
commands.response: resp_len=0; CC from writeSysInfo; CC 0x00 on full success.
commands.backendDeps: writeSysInfo(type=0xe8); Dell_shm_memread/write(region 0x30, offset 0xb868); DellPwrProfilesInfo_IPCClient; RunPowerInventory_DFSClient; RegisterBIOSVersionInLCL.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xea
commands.purpose: Set power budget. Delegates entirely to DellPwrSetPwrBudget(param_1, param_2, param_3) and returns its CC. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.

commands.response: CC and resp from DellPwrSetPwrBudget.

commands.name: DellCmdSetSysInfo/0xf0
commands.purpose: License-gated PCIe slot config commit. Requires d_licenseCheck(0x10) AND d_licenseCheck(4) to both return non-zero (else CC 0x6f = license error). Dispatches on param_1[10] (sub-type 0, 1, or 2) to populate different PCIe config buffer regions at DAT_4449dec4+0x4449e75c. When the accumulated record length matches a 'expected length' field, calls CfgSetAttributeInt four times to persist PCIe slot data to cfgdb, then CfgSetAttribute with the string payload, and clears the buffer. Source: libipmicmdtableapi.so.9.9.9.
commands.request: req[8]=0xf0; req[7]<0x14 (data_len-1 must be < 0x13); req[10]=sub_type (0,1,2; else CC 0xcc); req[0xc]=slot_count (for sub_type=0); req[0xd..]=slot record fields.

The written cfgdb attribute value is this raw byte.
commands.response: resp_len (param_2) is hardcoded to 2. Response data buffer (param_3): byte0=0x00, byte1=0x00, both hardcoded; their semantic meaning is undetermined (not derived from any input). Completion code is the handler's return value in r0, not a response-data byte: 0x00 on success, 0x01 on CfgSetAttributeInt failure. (Ghidra typed this function as void and rendered the live r0 value as an argument to __stack_chk_fail; the CC-in-r0 ABI is confirmed by sibling handler CmdOEMGetUEFIFlag, which returns its CC via r0 and uses param_3 purely for response data.)

commands.name: DellCmdGetBootstrapCredentials

The last byte of each 16-byte block (resp[16] and resp[32]) must be '\0' (null-terminator check on the IPC output); if either is non-zero the handler returns CC 0xff (0xe1 is only a dellprintf log argument, NOT the returned CC).
